purpose: Test the 14-line futex-v1 core present in both complete disabled traces while removing two entries observed only in replicate 2, avoiding v2's two replacement requests.

fixed_shared_prefix.policy: retain the 14 futex-v1 entries present in both complete disabled traces; shrink capacity instead of replacing the two replicate-specific entries

removed_line_observation: neither line appears in replicate 1; both appear in replicate 2, so they are trace-variable rather than unused

guardrails.required_comparison: opposite-order fresh-boot prefix14 versus disabled, followed by prefix14 versus futex-v1 only if both are stable
guardrails.rejection_rule: reject on any strict terminal failure; do not infer improvement from unpaired medians
